title: Real PHP 5.0.0 (PHP's own main(), 145 translation units) as a Linux process on the virtual profile, one image serving four allocator arms selected at run time by PHP_CAP_MODE
workload: the two populations of bug-corpora/php/engine-repros (46 asan-blind, 19 temporal-asan-visible), each trigger a .php script staged into the guest, judged by run-realphp.py through bug-corpora/tools/verdicts.py against the case's own oracle.json (our native ASan and pristine runs); php -n -v exits 1 as native PHP does and the stock arm's output matches the native build
status: builds through ports/common/application/build-virtual.sh php for both selector values and passes runtime/virtual/run.py --php 44/44 on dev 0b0b3414dca5 (results/2026-10-27-common-entry); rebuilt from scratch and smoke-tested the same day (results/2026-10-27-requalification).
